title: Claude Code on iOS: spotted the overload, botched the report
summary: Óscar Gallego recounts an agent correctly spotting a saturated Mac in a Simulator watchdog report, then inventing process-state and recovery claims in its incident summary. An iOS team can capture live command output and independently recount diagnostics before accepting causal explanations; his revised screenshot script still lacks a full rerun, and the overload’s exact cause remains unconfirmed.
takeaway: Save uptime, process states, booted devices, and diagnostic files while an incident is live; require evidence for each numeric or causal claim and independently recount at least one result.
